document.title: Auto Aim and Tracking System
document.description: Core developer and manager of an autonomous aiming and tracking system for robotic platforms. System tracks and predicts enemy robot movements, aligning shooters accordingly using ROS and C++.

## Overview

(Jan 2022 - Jun 2022)

Worked as core developer and technical manager of an autonomous aiming and tracking system designed to assist robot pilots in targeting and engaging enemy robots during competitive robotics events.

## Key Responsibilities

- **System Development**: Architected core auto-aim and tracking algorithms
- **Technical Leadership**: Managed development team for robust implementation
- **Motion Prediction**: Implemented predictive algorithms to anticipate enemy robot movements
- **Alignment Control**: Developed systems to dynamically align shooter mechanisms for accurate targeting

## Technical Implementation

### Tracking System
- Real-time tracking of enemy robot positions and movements
- Velocity estimation for predictive targeting

### Prediction Engine
- Motion prediction algorithms to anticipate robot trajectories
- Compensation for movement delays in shooter alignment

### Control System
- ROS-based framework for system coordination
- C++ implementation for performance-critical components
- Real-time response capabilities for dynamic environments

## Technology Stack

- **ROS (Robot Operating System)**: Core framework for robot communication and coordination
- **C++**: High-performance implementation for critical algorithms
- **Computer Vision**: Tracking and detection systems
- **Linux**: Development and deployment platform

## Impact

Significantly enhanced robot performance in autonomous aiming scenarios, providing pilots with intelligent targeting assistance that improved engagement success rates.

document.title: Autonomous Robot Development - Stereo Vision & Path Planning
document.description: Developed and implemented CSI stereo camera driver for depth sensing and path planning algorithms for autonomous robots using ROS and C++.

body.raw:
## Overview

(Jun 2021)

Development and implementation of critical perception and navigation systems for an autonomous robot platform, including stereo vision depth sensing and intelligent path planning.

## Key Components

### Stereo Camera Driver
- **CSI Stereo Camera Integration**: Developed custom driver for CSI (Camera Serial Interface) stereo camera
- **Depth Estimation**: Implemented algorithms to extract depth information from stereo pairs
- **Real-time Processing**: Optimized for real-time performance in robotic systems

### Path Planning System
- **Algorithm Development**: Implemented path planning algorithms for autonomous navigation
- **Obstacle Avoidance**: Integration with depth sensing for dynamic obstacle detection
- **Trajectory Generation**: Computed optimal paths for robot movement

## Technical Implementation

### Hardware Integration
- CSI Stereo Camera module
- Integration with ROS middleware
- Real-time sensor data processing

### Software Architecture
- ROS-based system design for modularity and scalability
- C++ implementation for performance-critical components
- Depth processing pipeline
- Path planning algorithms

## Technology Stack

- **ROS (Robot Operating System)**: Framework for sensor and algorithm coordination
- **C++**: High-performance implementation
- **Computer Vision**: Stereo vision and depth processing
- **Linux**: Development and deployment environment
- **Robotics**: Autonomous systems principles

## Impact

Enabled autonomous robots to perceive their environment through stereo vision and navigate intelligently using computed path planning, forming the foundation for autonomous navigation capabilities.

## Overview

TEMG 4940C Bond Portfolio Builder (Jul 2023 - Aug 2023)  
Associated with The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

**Winning Team** | **Team Leader & MVP**

Developed an ML-backed dashboard to assist bond trading and portfolio management activities, delivering impressive predictive accuracy on critical financial metrics.

## Key Achievements

- **80% Accuracy**: Credit Rating prediction model
- **Precise Z Spread Prediction**: Average error within 10 basis points
- **Winning Solution**: Recognized as winning team
- **MVP Recognition**: Named Most Valuable Player for contributions

## Technical Implementation

### Credit Rating Prediction
Machine learning model trained to predict bond credit ratings with 80% accuracy, enabling traders to quickly assess bond quality and risk.

### Z Spread Prediction
Developed Z Spread (Zero-Volatility Spread) prediction model with exceptional precision, averaging error within just 10 basis points - critical for bond valuation and trading decisions.

### Dashboard Features
- Real-time bond analysis
- Predictive metrics visualization
- Risk assessment tools
- Portfolio management interfaces

## Technology Stack

- Machine Learning (TensorFlow/PyTorch)
- Financial Analysis
- Predictive Analytics
- Data Visualization
- Dashboard Development

## Impact

Enabled bond traders at JPMorgan to make more informed trading decisions with ML-driven insights, improving portfolio performance and risk management.

document.title: Trading Strategy Using COVID-19 Influence on FANG+
document.description: Independent study project analyzing COVID-19's impact on FANG+ stock valuations using NLP semantic analysis and Time Series Forecasting with TensorFlow.

body.raw:
## Overview

COMP 4971C Independent Study Course (Sep 2021 - Dec 2021)  
Associated with The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

Developed a data-driven trading strategy analyzing the influence of COVID-19 pandemic on FANG+ technology company stock valuations using machine learning and natural language processing.

## Methodology

### Data Collection
- **CDC COVID-19 Statistics**: Aggregated official COVID-19 case and death data
- **Reddit Sentiment Data**: Collected Reddit posts discussing pandemic impacts
- **Market Data**: FANG+ stock price and valuation information

### NLP Analysis
- **Semantic Processing**: Applied open-source NLP tools for semantic analysis
- **Sentiment Extraction**: Analyzed Reddit post titles to extract sentiment signals about pandemic concerns
- **Trend Identification**: Identified correlations between public sentiment and market movements

### Predictive Modeling
- **Time Series Forecasting**: Developed TensorFlow-based models to predict future stock valuations
- **Feature Integration**: Combined COVID statistics and sentiment data as model inputs
- **Validation**: Backtested strategy performance against actual market outcomes

## Key Components

1. **Data Pipeline**: Python-based ETL pipeline for collecting and processing data
2. **NLP Engine**: Semantic analysis of social media and news sentiment
3. **ML Model**: TensorFlow time series model incorporating multi-source data
4. **Strategy Evaluation**: Performance metrics and risk assessment

## Technology Stack

- **Python**: Data collection and processing
- **NLP**: Open-source semantic analysis tools
- **Machine Learning**: TensorFlow for time series forecasting
- **Data Analysis**: Pandas, NumPy for statistical analysis

## Insights

The project demonstrated the relationship between pandemic sentiment (measured via social media and health statistics) and FANG+ stock performance, providing a data-driven framework for trading strategy development during periods of significant external shock.

document.title: Free Seat Detection within HKUST Library
document.description: Led development of a machine learning model using YOLOv8 for detecting chairs and belongings, alongside YOLOv8 Pose for determining occupancy. Integrated with custom Kalman filter for accurate seat availability assessment.

body.raw:
## Overview

Final Year Project at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Aug 2023 - May 2024)

Led the development of a machine learning-based seat detection system designed to help HKUST students find available seating in the university library.

## Technical Implementation

- **Object Detection**: Implemented YOLOv8 model for detecting chairs and personal belongings in library spaces
- **Pose Detection**: Utilized YOLOv8 Pose to classify whether individuals were sitting or standing
- **Tracking**: Integrated custom-modified Kalman filter for accurate occupancy tracking and state estimation
- **Data Pipeline**: Processed detected occupancy data and sent insights to a database
- **Mobile Integration**: Data supported a mobile application for real-time seat availability

## Technology Stack

- **Machine Learning**: PyTorch, YOLOv8
- **Computer Vision**: Object Detection, Pose Estimation
- **Filtering**: Kalman Filter (custom modifications)
- **Database**: Custom data pipeline for occupancy storage
- **Mobile**: Integration with mobile application

## Impact

The system provides real-time, accurate occupancy information to help students efficiently locate available seating in the HKUST library, reducing time spent searching for seats.

document.title: Global ETF Dashboard for JPMorgan Investment Banking
document.description: Winning team project (Objective 2) - Developed a semantic search ETF filtering dashboard with dynamic client-based news & ETF recommendations for JPMorgan salespeople. Team Leader focused on Technical Implementation and System Design.

body.raw:
## Overview

TEMG 4940C T&M Project Sponsored by JPMorgan Chase & Co (Sep 2023 - Dec 2023)  
Associated with The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

**Winning Team (Objective 2)** | **Team Leader**

Developed an intelligent dashboard prototype to assist JPMorgan Investment Banking salespeople in pitching ETF products to clients.

## Key Features

- **Semantic Search ETF Filtering**: Advanced natural language search capabilities for intelligent ETF discovery
- **Dynamic News Integration**: Real-time news aggregation and relevance analysis
- **Client-Based Recommendations**: Personalized ETF recommendations based on client profiles
- **Sales-Focused Design**: Intuitive interface optimized for JPMorgan salespeople

## Responsibilities

- **Team Leadership**: Led cross-functional team to deliver winning solution
- **Technical Implementation**: Architected and developed core system components
- **System Design**: Designed scalable, maintainable architecture for dashboard
- **Integration**: Connected semantic search, machine learning, and recommendation systems

## Technology Stack

- Machine Learning (recommendation engine)
- Full-Stack Development
- Semantic Search Technology
- Real-time Data Processing

## Impact

Created a powerful tool that enhances JPMorgan salespeople's ability to pitch tailored ETF solutions to clients, leveraging ML-driven insights and news analysis.

document.title: Splitzy
document.description: A personal alternative to Splitwise built out of frustration with transaction limits. Splitzy features an AI receipt scanner to automatically parse and split transactions among friends.

body.raw:
Splitzy is my personal alternative to Splitwise, created out of frustration with the arbitrary transaction limits imposed by Splitwise.

## Key Features

- **No Transaction Limits**: Unlike Splitwise, Splitzy allows you to add unlimited transactions without hitting arbitrary limits
- **AI Receipt Scanner**: Powered by machine learning, automatically scan and parse receipts to extract item details, amounts, and participants
- **Intelligent Expense Splitting**: Smart algorithms intelligently distribute costs among friends based on what each person actually purchased
- **Real-time Processing**: Get instant OCR results and automatic split calculations
- **User-Friendly Interface**: Clean, intuitive design for managing shared expenses with friends

## Technology Stack

Built with modern full-stack technologies to provide a seamless experience for expense tracking and intelligent splitting:

- **Frontend**: React/Next.js for responsive UI
- **AI/ML**: Receipt OCR and intelligent parsing
- **Backend**: Scalable backend for transaction management
- **Database**: Persistent storage for expense history and groups

## Why Splitzy?

Tired of Splitwise's transaction limits? Splitzy removes that friction and adds AI-powered receipt scanning to make splitting expenses easier and faster. Perfect for tracking group trips, shared housing, and frequent group dinners.
